reproduced_findings.summary: Non-exclusive idempotent submit transition allows two workers to call external submit for the same outbox intent.
reproduced_findings.required: exactly one worker receives external-mutation capability; loser reconciles only

reproduced_findings.summary: The same non-exclusive start pattern permits duplicate cancel/replace broker calls.
reproduced_findings.observed: 2 cancel / 2 replace invocations in race scenarios
reproduced_findings.required: exclusive mutation claim plus ambiguity-safe reconciliation

reproduced_findings.summary: Pending orders do not reserve cash or effective target exposure.
reproduced_findings.required: durable reservations included in every new-risk admission

reproduced_findings.summary: Implicit historical decision time can make old market data appear fresh when the operational caller omits an explicit clock context.
reproduced_findings.required: explicit replay clock versus operational wall/server clock contract

reproduced_findings.summary: A failed planning/readiness state does not durably revoke dispatch of an already outboxed risk-increasing order.
reproduced_findings.required: authoritative HALT/readiness recheck immediately before every risk-increasing external mutation

reproduced_findings.summary: PaperOrderLifecycle accepts an approved RiskDecision without immutable binding to the exact intent economics.
reproduced_findings.required: risk authorization bound to intent id + canonical economics + decision/revision identity

reproduced_findings.summary: Risk-increasing replace is not re-admitted against current limits before broker mutation.
reproduced_findings.observed: replace target 100000 reaches broker double with configured cap 110
reproduced_findings.required: recompute current+reserved exposure and re-admit every risk-increasing amendment

reproduced_findings.summary: Planning a second symbol can fail because existing positions lack authoritative valuation prices.
reproduced_findings.required: fresh valuation snapshot for every held/reserved symbol

reproduced_findings.summary: ProductConfig accepts target_quantity=0 while strategy construction rejects it.
reproduced_findings.required: one positive-quantity contract at configuration boundary

reproduced_findings.summary: A factual broker fill can be persisted before runtime projection fails, leaving OMS/runtime/durable portfolio views divergent.
reproduced_findings.required: immutable execution inbox plus restart-safe accounting projection state machine; factual broker executions never discarded

reproduced_findings.summary: The same persisted portfolio history can be replayed with a different arbitrary opening_cash value.
reproduced_findings.required: immutable account/session genesis plus explicit cash-flow events

reproduced_findings.summary: Rejected unauthenticated trade-update digest enters stream dedup before semantic authorization; exact replay can bypass stream validation and reach accounting.
reproduced_findings.required: validated/authenticated stream provenance is required before accounting authority

reproduced_findings.summary: Configured operational risk limits can silently become non-operative when optional measured inputs are absent.
reproduced_findings.observed: restrictive liquidity/concentration/sector/volatility limits still returned approved=true with minimal default context
reproduced_findings.required: operational mode fails closed on every missing observation required by an enabled limit

reproduced_findings.summary: Invalid final bar timestamp can raise naive/aware TypeError instead of deterministic fail-closed quality evidence.
reproduced_findings.required: invalid input returns ready=false with stable reason and no uncaught type error

reproduced_findings.summary: Default walk-forward qualifier can report qualified=true with zero trades and zero active windows.
reproduced_findings.required: non-vacuous minimum trades/windows/regimes/sample/cost/OOS criteria before qualification

reproduced_findings.summary: Market-data validator is not mandatory in canonical signal/risk path.
reproduced_findings.observed: 30-day-old gapped bars were quality-failed but still generated an approved BUY
reproduced_findings.required: validated operational data snapshot is a mandatory precondition for risk-increasing planning

reproduced_findings.summary: Submit response with materially different broker-returned order economics can be accepted as ACKNOWLEDGED.
reproduced_findings.observed: limit 100 requested; broker double returned 150; local OMS accepted ACK and retained 100
reproduced_findings.required: strict broker-response identity/economics validation with explicit venue normalization tolerance; otherwise UNCERTAIN

reproduced_findings.summary: Reconciliation can replace an established broker order id without explicit replacement lineage.
reproduced_findings.observed: broker-A was silently rewritten to broker-B for the same client order id
reproduced_findings.required: immutable primary broker identity or explicit replaces/replaced_by lineage proven by mutation evidence

reproduced_findings.summary: Immediate submit fill updates OMS but not portfolio before the next planning cycle.
reproduced_findings.observed: OMS FILLED/1, runtime position 0, then a second BUY 1 was planned and approved
reproduced_findings.required: submit fills enter durable execution/accounting pipeline and new risk remains blocked until convergence

reproduced_findings.summary: Reused intent_id with changed economics is treated as idempotent success.
reproduced_findings.observed: first BUY 1@100, replay BUY 9@999 under same intent id returned original OUTBOXED record
reproduced_findings.required: intent_id is immutable economic identity; divergent replay raises INTENT_ID_CONFLICT on SQLite/PostgreSQL

release_packaging_findings.summary: Core PostgreSQL migration defaults migrations/product/001-004 are absent from both qualified wheel and sdist, so installed build_postgres_product(..., migrate=true) is not self-contained.
Canonical Bybit v119-v121 Python persistence/control modules ship without corresponding root migration resources in wheel/sdist.
Installed console scripts are mostly engineering/audit/platform commands; one supported canonical product operator/service interface is absent.
The sdist contains tests that import omitted tests.conftest/tests.helpers_v108 and therefore does not self-reproduce its distributed test suite.
Release integrity proves build/hash/SBOM/provenance but does not clean-install the built wheel and verify packaged runtime resources/bootstrap/offline self-test.

qualification_findings.summary: PR workflow run metadata names the branch head while actions/checkout tests refs/pull/<n>/merge; branch candidate head and tested synthetic merge identity must be recorded separately.
qualification_findings.required: explicit literal exact-head mechanism if policy requires literal head qualification

qualification_findings.summary: operational-readiness workflow push trigger targets historical branch agent/schema108-paper-core-foundation rather than canonical main.
qualification_findings.required: continuous post-merge readiness qualification on main for relevant paths
